title: Viva Engage: network analytics gets custom date ranges, faster refresh and people-manager filters
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout facts match the roadmap record, and Microsoft Learn supports the existing filtering control, roles and licensing requirements. The new manager filters, their privacy protections and their enablement details remain undocumented in the sources searched, as the briefing states.
